Troubleshooting · 22/50 · localization

Forced-narrative subtitle missing

Failure signal

A forced-narrative subtitle missing condition is reported or detected during localization.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for localization does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Review foreign dialogue and story-critical on-screen text against the spotting list.

Corrective action

Author the missing forced cue and test it in every required language stream.

Prevention

Add this verification to the localization gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
